Melanocytic skin neoplasm arising on the eyelid; both cutaneous origin and eyelid location are explicit.

HARP combines lipid/metabolic abnormality, acanthocytosis and pallidal degeneration; retinitis pigmentosa is a defining diagnostic feature.
Hypothalamic tumors cause neuroendocrine dysfunction and cachexia; hypothalamic-pituitary abnormalities occur in 80-99%. Optic atrophy is occasional (5-29%).
